description: Era one-piece toy wheel (spec 4b rule 3): narrow hard black plastic ring (smooth tread, faint mould line, no rubber sidewall) moulded round a vacuum-chromed fan disc (8 thick swept vanes, fat outer lip, centre boss with a through hole for the axle head).
units: uu (1 uu = 1/16 real cm); FBX authored in Blender metres, 1 m = 100 uu
outer_face: Blender +Y = left side of the car. After the FBX import that is UE -Y (left). Use as-is on the LEFT wheels (FL, RL); rotate 180 deg yaw for the RIGHT wheels (FR, RR). The vanes are swept, a yaw (not a mirror) keeps them correct.
normals: authored (analytic). Import normals, do not recompute.
toy_imperfection: give each wheel a fixed random camber/toe of up to +/-0.5 deg (the cars' sidecars list the preview values)

uv.UV1: planar side projection (hub face centred at 0.5,0.5)

scale_note: If another casting needs a different radius, scale uniformly by radius/9.8.
